original_test_intent: Upgrade the intended GPU to the exact approved newer VBIOS and prove programming, activation, version change and post-flash health, with recoverable evidence.
original_method: Bind index 0 to stable GPU identity, verify signed compatible image/tool and current/target version direction, back up current ROM, preflight stable power and recovery path, execute vendor-approved programming once, activate as required, then verify version, identity, GPU/link/driver health and logs.
manual_activity: GPU firmware owner approves tool/image/target/activation and recovery, supervises uninterrupted programming and decides verdict.
required_inputs: Signed amdvbflash hash/version and vendor command guide
Current ROM backup/read method and known-good recovery image
Stable power, maintenance, activation, OOB and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Verify target and image compatibility twice before write
Back up/hash current ROM and confirm recovery readiness
Use stable redundant power and no automatic retry
Do not interrupt once programming begins; follow vendor progress/abort rules
After activation stop on identity/version/link/driver/health anomaly and recover deliberately
agent_execution_scope: Present exact vendor-approved command for confirmation
Execute one authorized flash and capture progress
Perform post checks/report; never choose image/index or retry
engineer_actions: Review program/post-health evidence and set outcome

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its `-f` command differs materially from source `-p 0` and cannot be used without vendor semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after approval execute the vendor-confirmed equivalent of `./amdvbflash -p 0 <approved-image>` against the stable-mapped GPU once, then activate and verify comprehensively.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS boot, target index 0 and source program form are retained; placeholder is replaced only by approved image.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed flash manifest binding tool/image/current ROM/target identity and expected version, with preflight interlock and post-activation health checklist.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds required provenance, identity, recovery and activation evidence to the destructive one-line command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only version display, downgrade or a flash of any other adapter is insufficient.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Tool success does not prove firmware bootability until required activation and post-health complete.

project_override_considerations: Firmware owner defines approved upgrade path, image compatibility, command semantics, activation and recovery for the exact board/SKU.
expected_evidence: Signed tool/image hashes, release/support approval and flash manifest
Stable target identity plus current ROM/version/backup hash
Power/OOB/recovery readiness and exact confirmed argv
Activation and expected target VBIOS/version/ROM identity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master upgrade intent and program command are coherent; DeepSeek's differing flag is rejected as non-authoritative advice.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Image, vendor procedure and recovery inputs can be supplied; critical execution remains approval-gated.

review_improvement: Turns index-based destructive flashing into a signed target-bound, recoverable upgrade transaction with activation and post-health proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Adapter index can change across topology/boot state, so the write target must be bound to BDF/serial/slot/SKU immediately before programming. A zero exit can indicate only transfer completion; the new ROM must activate and enumerate with healthy link/driver state. Backup and recovery must exist before the irreversible interval, not be improvised after a failure.
